nodes.description: Public pure function that maps a uint256 slot to a hard-coded 24-element string array of background color labels and returns the label at index slot % names.length.
Public pure function that maps a uint256 slot to a hard-coded 24-element string array of hex color codes and returns an ABI-packed SVG rect fragment using the color at index slot % colors.length.
Caller-supplied uint256 index parameter of getLabel; reduced modulo the constant array length 24 before indexing, so it is always inside the array bounds.
Caller-supplied uint256 index parameter of getData; reduced modulo the constant array length 24 before indexing, so it is always inside the array bounds.
Memory local array of 24 color-name strings built inside getLabel and read at the modulo-derived index.
Memory local array of 24 hex color-code strings built inside getData and read at the modulo-derived index.

edges.reason: The getLabel slot parameter flows into the modulo array-index expression and drives the returned label string.
The local names array is read by getLabel and its selected element is returned to the caller.
The getData slot parameter flows into the modulo array-index expression and drives the returned color code.
The local colors array is read by getData and abi.encodePacked into the returned bytes.

Both public entry points belong to the same contract and are independently reachable external functions with identical indexing patterns but no call relationship, so the control-flow relation is only structural.

normalization_plan.reason: The slot parameter is a temporary non-core value used only inside getLabel; it must be absorbed into the getLabel function node.
The slot parameter is a temporary non-core value used only inside getData; it must be absorbed into the getData function node.
The names array is a purely local memory structure created and consumed within getLabel; it should be folded into the getLabel function node.
The colors array is a purely local memory structure created and consumed within getData; it should be folded into the getData function node.
